title: Question on the page "searchBox"
body:
Hi! I have a documentation issue on InstantSearch.js. I could not find what I was looking for on the page "[searchBox](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/widgets/searchBox.html)".

Hello, I am new to algolia and even with instant search.
I have a question for you, I am trying to filter out results based on the radius(35miles) around some point (latitude and longitude). I am trying to use searchBox. Can you please let me know how can I use aroundRadius and aroundLatLng with it. I have searched a lot but could not find any way to implement this. Please share your thoughts and suggestion. Thanks in advance.
